# Test-count baseline (Phase 0 gate).
#
# `scripts/check-test-count.sh` fails when the number of passing tests drops
# below this number, so a phase that silently removes or breaks tests is caught
# in CI. Phase work is expected to *raise* the count; when a phase
# intentionally replaces tests, update this file in the same change and say so
# in the commit message.
49
